outcome: A user can state a new career target during an unfinished mock and recall it in a fresh thread; the target is not rubric-scored.
root_cause: Pending-mock capture classifies short narrative-led I want / I am aiming statements as answers, while the existing early goal owner recognizes only my goal is declarations. The canonical explicit form already works on the base.
fix: An assertion-only career-target parser is shared by stored goal capture and the early goal claim. Labeled answers, requests, questions, hypotheticals and quoted speech do not enter the new frame.
runtime_scope: Local real-host/store semantics with invented synthetic profile and mock; no provider, database, browser or employer access. Shared generated router bundles intentionally not regenerated; root serializes them.
